name: mnemonic_fissure_cannon
label: Mnemonic Fissure Cannon
poeticVision: The player will feel the cold, agonizing choice of sacrificing a piece of their very being for a fleeting chance at survival. Every trigger pull is a silent scream against the tide of forgetting, watching a precious memory fray and dissolve into a weapon's energy. It's the ultimate desperate act, a paradox of fighting for identity by willingly letting it go.

parameters.name: fire_cost_per_shot
parameters.description: Percentage of the loaded MemoryShard's integrity consumed with each shot.

parameters.name: projectile_scene
parameters.description: The PackedScene for the projectile that the cannon will instantiate and fire.

parameters.name: fire_rate_seconds
parameters.description: The minimum time in seconds between consecutive shots.

parameters.name: muzzle_node
parameters.description: A Node3D representing the muzzle of the cannon, determining where projectiles spawn and in which direction they are fired.

dependencies: A projectile scene (e.g., 'fissure_projectile.tscn') with a MeshInstance3D using the custom shader and optionally a script with a 'set_degradation_level' method.
verdict: A weapon forged from the very essence of self-loss, it forces a desperate dance between survival and the agonizing erosion of identity.
impact: The player experience will be fundamentally shaped by the agonizing decisions forced by this weapon. Every shot fired will be a tangible sacrifice of their character's very being, creating a constant, visceral tension between survival and self-preservation. It transforms combat into a desperate, existential struggle, making every victory bittersweet and every loss deeply personal, directly embodying the game's core theme of identity erosion.
